definitions.explanation: A written guide that provides instructions, procedures, or information on how to do something. Used for everything from workplace procedures to government forms.

examples.japanese: {手引|てび}き{書|しょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き{書|しょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ダウンロード→ダウンロード：04725_daunroodo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I downloaded the tax filing guidebook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き{書|しょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配|くば}られる→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: New employees are given a work procedures manual.

notes: Compound of ⟦{手引|てび}き→手引き：12759_tebiki⟧ (guidance) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document/book). Common collocations: {手引|てび}き{書|しょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧ (to create a guidebook), {手引|てび}き{書|しょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧ (to follow the guidebook). Similar words: ⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧ (manual, often for products or software), ガイドブック (guidebook, especially for travel), ⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧ (instruction manual). {手引|てび}き{書|しょ} has a slightly formal tone and is often used in administrative or workplace contexts.
